notes: Official/public source evidence snapshots/manifests as legally permitted. client-assets/15.30/manifest.json remains a checksum-only 15.30 client asset manifest; owner-authorized redistributable client files may be staged under content/assets/files/ with provenance and rights recorded there. tibia-com/<YYYY-MM-DD>/ (legacy) and tibia-com/<YYYY-MM-DD-HHMMSSZ>/ hold owner-run tibia.com manual/spell-library capture snapshots (tools/official-capture/tibiacom_capture.py): a manifest.json (url, fetched_at, http_status, sha256 per page; never full page text) and a facts.json of short extracted facts. Each snapshot directory is immutable once committed; a new capture adds a new run directory rather than overwriting one. appearance-membership/ holds the A12 digest-bound membership manifests (object ids and digests only) of every admitted CipSoft appearances.dat and their admitted.json index.
